title: Natural open restriction square for pinned single-degree tensor counits
statement: Fix derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback]. For a cartesian square f:X→S, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′ [def-pc-fibre-product], integer n, and opens V⊆S, W⊆S′ with W⊆g⁻¹V, put U=f⁻¹V, fA=f|V, gA=g|W, P=U×_V W, p:P→U, q:P→W, and r:G↦G|U [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let T_Y embed modules on Y as single complexes in degree n, and R be derived restriction to W. Define d_k(M,n) by the component of the composition-pinned tensor counit [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], followed by the termwise single-complex identification; this is a real construction. There exist natural isomorphisms a:T_X⋙Rf_*⋙Lg*⋙R≅r⋙T_U⋙RfA_*⋙LgA* and b:g′*_tensor⋙T_X′⋙Rf′_*⋙R≅r⋙p*_tensor⋙T_P⋙Rq_* such that for every module G, R(β(T_X G)≫Rf′_*(d_g′(G,n)))≫b_G=a_G≫(βA(T_U(rG))≫Rq_*(d_p(rG,n))). Here β and βA are the recorded derived base-change maps [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No arbitrary counit comparison is quantified; a,b are natural in G. All integer degrees, zero modules and empty opens are allowed.

proof.text: Apply the degree-zero open pinned square to obtain natural comparison isomorphisms a0,b0 and its commuting component equation.

Apply shift covariance of the pinned base-change composite globally after restriction to W, and locally with the identity functor on D(W). Whisker the latter comparisons by module restriction. Conjugate the shifted a0 and b0 by these source and target shift isomorphisms. Apply the shift functor to the degree-zero component equation. The two shift-covariance equations and cancellation of the inverse comparison isomorphisms yield the degree-n square, uniformly for every G.

theorem open_pinned_single_degree_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (n : ℤ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let fA := f ∣_ V
    let gA := g.resLE V W hWV
    let p := pullback.fst fA gA
    let q := pullback.snd fA gA
    let T := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n
    let T0 := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n
    let T' := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) n
    let TP := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) n
    let R := (schemeOpenRestriction S' W).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ a : ((T ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) ⋙ derivedPullback g) ⋙ R ≅
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X U ⋙ T0) ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage fA) ⋙
          derivedPullback gA,
    ∃ b : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g' ⋙ T') ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f') ⋙ R ≅
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X U ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p) ⋙ TP) ⋙
          schemeDerivedDirectImage q,
    ∀ G : X.Modules,
      R.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w (T.obj G) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map (pinnedSingleDegreeTensorComparison g' G n)) ≫
        b.hom.app G =
      a.hom.app G ≫
        (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap fA q gA p pullback.condition
            (T0.obj ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj G)) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage q).map
            (pinnedSingleDegreeTensorComparison p ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj G) n))
